subject: APAC night-window onboarding — slot proposal and backup
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@kiripay.com>, Tom Ellis <tellis@kiripay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-12-05T02:13:00Z
Subject: APAC night-window onboarding — slot proposal and backup

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks again for signing up for the onboarding package. We want to make the console walkthrough + API enablement as frictionless as possible. Because your core product team is in Singapore and engineering overlaps with EU hours, we recommend running the live session in an APAC-evening / US-morning window so your SREs can join without an early-morning call.

Proposed primary slot (SGT):
- Thursday, 14 Dec — 21:00–22:30 SGT (UTC+8) — 90m session: console walkthrough (45m) + API keys & quick integration (45m)

Backup slot (SGT):
- Friday, 15 Dec — 08:00–09:30 SGT — in case your APAC lead needs an earlier overlap with EU

We can split into two 60m blocks if you'd prefer a narrower focus on the API and follow with a hands-on lab later. Attached is a draft agenda (redwood_onboard_agenda_v1.pdf).

Next steps: please confirm which slot works or suggest a 30–60m shift. If you can share the attendee list and preferred demo focus (console vs API vs both), we'll lock the calendar and send a runbook.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

---
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform

Date: 2028-12-05T05:41:00Z
Subject: Re: APAC night-window onboarding — slot proposal and backup

Jordan —

Thanks for the options. The primary slot on Thu 14 Dec at 21:00 SGT looks closest to workable, but we have an internal product sync that day that usually runs a bit late. Would you be able to push the start by 30 minutes (21:30–23:00 SGT) instead?

Attendees likely: me (PM), Tom (Platform), Ravi Kumar (infra lead), and possibly 1–2 engineers from payments. We want the session to focus on: console walkthrough (how to pin model versions + rollout policy) and API examples for streaming + batching.

I reviewed the agenda quickly — the v1 looks good. If you have a slightly later start that’s preferable.

Best,
Asha Kapoor
Head of Platform — Kiri Pay
asha@kiripay.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@kiripay.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Ellis <tellis@kiripay.com>
Date: 2028-12-05T18:12:00Z
Subject: Re: APAC night-window onboarding — slot proposal and backup

Thanks for the quick note, Asha — 21:30 SGT works for me.

Couple of operational notes from our side:
- We recommend keeping the session at 90m but with a 10m buffer at the end for account-specific follow-ups. Proposed flow: 30m console deep-dive (models, rollouts, observability), 45m API integration lab (keys, streaming example, batching tips), 15m Q&A / mutual action planning.
- I attached an updated agenda focused on the streaming example and quantization recommendations for your payments workload (redwood_onboard_agenda_v2.pdf).
- I can own the API code walkthrough; Jordan will cover rollouts & console SLOs; Ben will run the hands-on lab and credential provisioning.

Operational asks for Kiri Pay before the session:
1) Confirm final attendee list (names + emails).
2) Grant sandbox access for 2 engineers (we'll request temporary keys and a separate sandbox org).
3) Share one sample prompt / inference workload pattern (typical seq length, tokens per call) so Ben can tailor the batching demo.

If 21:30 SGT is locked, I will: create the calendar invite (with both SGT and UTC times), upload the runbook, and add a short mutual action plan spreadsheet (mutual_action_plan.xlsx) to the invite. If anything changes, please flag in this thread and I'll update.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199

Date: 2028-12-06T01:02:00Z

Great — locking 14 Dec, 21:30–23:00 SGT (Thursday) as the confirmed time. I created a calendar event and added the runbook + updated agenda: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh.

Quick checklist for the session (please reply in-thread with items you can confirm):
- Asha: final attendee list + confirm Ravi and the two engineers if possible
- Kiri Pay infra: sandbox access for 2 engineers (we will send an invite for temporary keys the day before)
- Camila/Ben: we'll run the streaming example with a 512-token typical prompt; Ben will pre-seed the sandbox with a small dataset.

I’ve also uploaded a short mutual action plan to the invite and linked the HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/8342). If we need to split into two focused blocks, we can bump the API lab to a separate follow-up, but my vote is to keep the single 90m block and use the last 15m for next steps.

If anything else pops up, we'll coordinate here. Thanks everyone — excited to get Kiri Pay live.

Jordan Blake
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182
